name: MK-677 (Ibutamoren)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: MK-677 (Ibutamoren) is a small-molecule research compound supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 5 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is MK-677 (Ibutamoren) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Testing for MK-677 (Ibutamoren): HPLC purity against ≥99.0% (HPLC), MS confirmation of the intact mass, and a documented identity record (CAS 159634-47-6, formula C27H36N4O5S, 528.7 Da). Results are reported per lot, not as a catalogue average.

faq.question: How should MK-677 (Ibutamoren) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for MK-677 (Ibutamoren): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the MK lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for MK-677 (Ibutamoren)?
faq.answer: MK-677 (Ibutamoren) is stocked in 1 pack size (5 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $11.14; 10–49 kits falls to $10.24 (−8%) and 50+ to $9.46 (−15%).
